From: Lukas Meier <billing@fintegrate.eu>

Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Clarification: VAT treatment for Redwood services (EU/GST withholding)

Hi Aisha,

We're preparing payment for Redwood invoices but procurement has flagged VAT treatment for cross-border services. Fintegrate is a DE-registered company but we have multiple entities (DE and UK) that consume your hosted API. Our AP team needs confirmation:

- Does Redwood apply reverse-charge (zero-rate, customer responsible) for EU B2B services when we provide a valid DE VAT number?
- Is Redwood able to issue a split invoice (DE entity billed for EU consumption, UK entity billed separately) or support self-billing if we provide a certificate?
- What evidence do you require to remove VAT from the current outstanding invoice so we can release payment?

We'd prefer not to have the invoice stuck in AP for longer than the usual terms — procurement asked for a list of required documents and any suggested process (self-billing or reissue) so they can take action.

Thanks,
Lukas
Finance Ops | Fintegrate GmbH
attachments: none

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meier <billing@fintegrate.eu>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Clarification: VAT treatment for Redwood services (EU/GST withholding)

Hi Lukas — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front: yes, reverse-charge typically applies for EU B2B SaaS when we have a valid VAT registration for the buyer; we can also support self-billing in some cases or reissue split invoices if you have separate legal entities.

What we need from you to proceed:
- Official VAT registration numbers for each paying/legal entity (formatted with country code) and the name that appears on the tax registry.
- A copy of the VAT registration certificate (scan/PDF) for the DE entity if you want us to zero-rate the existing invoice.
- If you prefer self-billing: please complete and sign the attached selfbilling-template.xlsx and return with the VAT certs.

Operational notes:
- If we receive the VAT certificate and it validates in EU VIES, we'll reissue the invoice net of VAT and mark it as reverse-charged; we can expedite within 24–48 hours of receiving valid docs.
- For split billing across entities we will need a PO or written confirmation from your procurement specifying which entity will be billed for which account(s)/routes — our Finance team will set up two invoices and route collections accordingly.
- While we validate, we can place the outstanding invoice on a temporary hold at AP's request (please confirm you want a hold) to avoid duplicate charging.

I've attached a short evidence checklist and the self-billing template to this message for your AP team. If you can send the PDFs this morning we should be able to clear it before the payment date.

Attachments: redwood-vat-evidence-checklist.pdf; selfbilling-template.xlsx

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, EMEA | Redwood Inference
